name: webfetch-cache
description: Short-circuits repeated WebFetch calls for the same URL and prompt within a session, answering { result } from cache without a network round trip. A tool.call hook with TTL and size limits.

ttlSeconds.title: TTL (seconds)
ttlSeconds.description: How long a cached WebFetch result stays fresh

maxEntries.title: Max entries
maxEntries.description: How many URL + prompt pairs to keep
